speaker: Doctor

Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing left chest pain, a productive cough with purulent sputum, and shortness of breath; have you had any fever or chills recently? 

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, C-Reactive_Protein

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: Hemoglobin: 14 mg/dL, Hematocrit: 45%, Leukocyte_count: 12,000/mm3, Neutrophils: 82%, Lymphocytes: 15%, Monocytes: 3%, Platelet_count: 270,000/mm3; C-Reactive_Protein: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work shows elevated neutrophils, which often points to a bacterial infection. Have you noticed any recent exposure to sick contacts, and does the pain worsen when you take a deep breath?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-ray: Alveolar infiltrates in the left base with air bronchograms

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bacterial Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe)
